subject: SlateMatchmaking — credit eligibility & onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@slatematch.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SlateMatchmaking — credit eligibility & onboarding checklist

Hi Samir —

Great speaking yesterday. As promised, I wanted to put next steps in writing so we can fast-track your pilot with SlateMatch into our startup program. Proposal summary:

- Complimentary compute credits: request for 50k token-equivalent credits for a 90-day pilot.
- Trial extension: extend hosted trial from 14 to 60 days during onboarding.
- Requirement: completion of our security questionnaire and a short mutual action plan (MAP).

Can you confirm the primary integration scope (ingest volumes, expected RPS, and whether KV caching will be used)? I’ve attached a draft MAP and the security questionnaire. If you confirm, I’ll route for internal approvals — looping in Marissa and Ben for program sign-off.

Next steps I propose:
1) Samir confirms scope + priority workloads (by EOD Wed)
2) We finalize MAP and security Q (3 business days)
3) Redwood issues credits & onboarding kickoff call (within 48 hours of approvals)

Thanks — excited to get SlateMatch into the program.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Attachments: SLM_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf, security-questionnaire-SlateMatch.xlsx

From: Samir Patel <samir@slatematch.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@slatematch.io>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SlateMatchmaking — credit eligibility & onboarding checklist

Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the quick follow-up. Priya and I reviewed the MAP and the questionnaire. High level scope:

- Ingest: ~120k messages/day initially, expected to grow to ~400k/day over 2 months.
- Traffic profile: bursty during batch ingest windows; low steady-state RPS otherwise.
- Feature priority: vector search + reranking; we will use prefix-based KV caching for session continuity.

We can complete the security questionnaire today — attaching a scanned copy with answers. For credits: 50k would be helpful to cover initial model tuning, but if there’s internal policy constraints you can suggest an amount.

Also, can we get a 60-day extension rather than 30? Our launch window depends on the additional time to validate privacy controls.

Appreciate the help — Samir

—
Samir Patel
Head of Product, SlateMatch
samir@slatematch.io
Phone: +1 415-555-0137

Attachment: security-questionnaire-SlateMatch.xlsx (completed)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SlateMatchmaking — credit eligibility & onboarding checklist

Marissa, Ben, Laura — forwarding Samir’s answers and the completed security questionnaire. Quick context: SlateMatch is an early-stage marketplace product (pre-series A) with strong usage signal and a partner strategy that could surface additional PLG leads. They’re asking for 50k credits + a 60-day extension.

Why I think we should approve:
- Product fit: heavy use of reranking/embeddings which maps to our cost-saving suggestions (batching + KV caching).
- Upside: potential pilot-to-paid conversion given partner pipeline and demo commitment next month.
- Risk: standard startup security items — they completed the questionnaire but flagged a third-party analytics vendor that will be blocked until we confirm data flows.

Requesting:
- Program credit approval amount (recommend 45k credits as compromise)
- Trial extension to 60 days (onboarding team can set milestone gates)
- Any legal triggers we should be aware of (Laura)

MAP + completed security questionnaire are attached. If I don’t hear back by EOD, I’ll follow up tomorrow.

Thanks —
Jordan

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed their MAP and the questionnaire. Quick notes:

- Qualification: SlateMatch aligns with our startup program criteria (pre-A, clear GTM pilot, reasonable tech maturity).
- Suggested credit allocation: 40,000 compute credits with an automatic review at 30 days tied to recorded onboarding milestones (ingest completed, reranking test pass).
- Trial extension: OK to 60 days, but require milestone gating as noted.
- Security: Laura — please confirm whether the third-party analytics vendor response is a blocker or just a configurational note.

I’m fine to green-light the program side with those guardrails. I’ve attached a short qualification memo (internal) summarizing why they qualify.

All —

Finance reviewed the proposed concession. We can approve a credit grant of 45,000 compute credits and sign off on a 60-day trial extension. Conditions:

- Credits are non-refundable and expire 90 days after issuance if unused.
- Require legal to confirm the standard pilot terms; if they request contract redlines beyond standard PLG pilot SOW, escalate.
